written.headline: Axon invests $1.2B in drone manufacturer Skydio at $5.2B valuation
written.summary: Axon invested $1.2 billion in drone manufacturer Skydio at a $5.2 billion pre-money valuation, acquiring a minority stake. The agreement also makes Axon the exclusive public safety distributor for Skydio in the U.S. and Canada.

written.headline: Censys discovers 800+ publicly exposed copies of ARTEX AI hacking tool
written.summary: Censys discovered more than 800 publicly exposed copies of ARTEX, a Chinese-made, open-source, AI-powered penetration testing tool linked to cyberattacks since July. The tool's original GitHub repository was taken down in October due to widespread threat actor abuse.

written.headline: Sand.ai raises $200M Series A+ and achieves unicorn status
written.summary: Beijing-based video-generation startup Sand.ai raised a $200 million Series A+ round, bringing its total funding over 10 months to $300 million and giving it a valuation over $1 billion. The investment was jointly led by CoStone Capital and Wangsu Science & Technology.

written.headline: Oracle India says firms are moving from AI pilots to full-scale production
written.summary: Indian businesses have shifted from AI pilot tests to full-scale enterprise production over the past year and a half. Oracle India head Shailender Kumar reported that firms are realizing tangible benefits despite challenges involving cost, infrastructure, and skills.
